profile.headline: FullStack Software Engineer | Built Mission Critical Cloud and Distributed Applications serving Government & Public Sectors | JavaScript, C# .NET, Java Spring, Postgres, Oracle, MongoDB
profile.summary:
I'm a Lead Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of clean architecture, cloud-native systems, and cross-functional leadership. Over the past 14+ years, I’ve delivered scalable enterprise solutions across aerospace, healthcare, energy, and federal domains; I enjoy modernizing legacy systems, driving cloud adoption, and building high-impact teams.

Whether I’m designing secure, multi-tenant microservices in AWS, integrating C++ trajectory code into air traffic systems, or leading agile teams as a Scrum Master and Product Owner, I bring a practical, systems-level mindset to everything I build.

Recent highlights:

Designed a HIPAA-compliant cloud platform with reusable microservice frameworks, reducing development ramp-up by 90%

Led engineering and process modernization for a team of 10, improving testing efficiency by 33%

Built Java/Spring APIs and Angular front ends for real-time systems used in national air traffic control

Spearheaded swarm-based defect resolution practices, cutting backlog by 95%

I’m a hands-on builder who balances architecture with implementation, and someone who enjoys mentoring engineers, improving DevOps workflows, and pushing teams toward cleaner code and faster feedback loops.

Technical toolkit: C#, Java, C++, TypeScript, Spring Boot, .NET, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, XML, SQL, MongoDB, Helm, MassTransit
Methodologies: Agile (SAFe/Scrum), CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, event-driven design

When I’m not writing code or mentoring teams, you’ll probably find me deep in a strategy RPG, slinging spells in Magic: The Gathering, or running a tabletop campaign where chaos is the rule and good design still matters.

Let’s connect whether it’s about distributed systems, clean architecture, or your favorite turn-based combat system.

positions.title: Scrum Master
positions.description:
●	Facilitated sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives for a team of 10 members.
●	Conducted meetings with other development teams and architects, reducing integration conflicts by 15%.
●	Facilitated backlog refinements and sprint planning sessions.
●	Participated in Product Owner signoff at the end of each sprint, showcasing developed stories in System Review to other development teams and stakeholders.
●	Mentored team members on career paths and technology interests.
●	Organized meetings to review defects, leading to a 95% reduction in open defects and a 33% increase in testing efficiency through the implementation of a swarm method for user story test cases.
●	Conducted 3 backlog refinement meetings per sprint, which improved the accuracy of story writing and reduced sprint planning time by 15% through enhanced team participation.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Served as Lead Developer, Scrum Master, and Product Owner, overseeing technical architecture, 
agile execution, and product planning.
●	Designed a HIPAA-compliant, multi-tenant cloud system with secure data isolation.
●	Architected C# .NET micro-services with independent PostgreSQL stores.
●	Modeled access-controlled database schemas tailored to complex business requirements.
●	Developed foundational, reusable libraries and components for API design, configuration management, and data isolation—accelerating microservice development by up to 90%.
●	Implemented reusable components and APIs enabling historical data tracking, versioning, and audit trails, supporting regulatory compliance across services.
●	Standardized the SDLC with Git workflows, Bitbucket PR policies, reviewer roles, and unit test metrics; authored comprehensive documentation to support onboarding, test coverage, and code quality.
●	Built extensible property systems for dynamic microservice configuration and customer onboarding.
●	Customized containers and applications using Helm and Kubernetes.

positions.title: Software Engineer T3
positions.description:
ERAM Adaptation Data Processing (EADP)
●	Design and develop Oracle Forms. 	
●	Develop and maintain Oracle Procedures. 	
●	Model data for Adaptation. 	
●	Develop and maintain Oracle Tables 	
●	Update and maintain EADP documentation.
Enterprise Information Display System (E-IDS)
●	Develop and Deploy RESTful API using Java, Spring Framework, MongoDB, and Docker. 	
●	Model data for storage in MongoDB. 	
●	Redesign Java to reduce classes resulting in less required features and time in Sprints. 	
●	Initiated Spring Framework and Docker training sessions for the software team. 	
●	Develop Bash scripts to increase software and test workflow in Docker environment. 	
●	Develop E-IDS UI using Angular, PrimeNG, and MongoDB.
Time-Based Flow Management (TBFM)
●	Analyze defects in conjunction with the SE team to design solutions.
●	Develop C/C++ adaptation functionality for link.
●	Develop C/C++ trajectory functionality for TSAS.
●	Lead development on SIG efforts on RA/TS/SPPR programs.
●	Maintain and run regression test plans to verify program functionality.
Development Tools
●	Develop and maintain shell and Perl tools to assist in defect investigation.
●	Integrate shell scripts to common tools to limit expensive tasks across teams.
●	Refactor Perl and shell scripts to improve efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Research & Development
    • Utilize telemetered data from RTUs to develop and maintain SCADA applications.
    • Utilize Java API to build and update Web UI Front End for EMS(Energy Management System).
    • Mentor junior engineers in SCADA application development.
    • Provide maintenance for defects of base version of EMS(Energy Management System) product.
    • Maintain, update, and run test plans.
    • Developed Perl script to convert Fortran strings from ASCII to UCS-4 for multilingual support.
    • Developed logfile configuration to allow applications to specify verbosity, size, and count.

	Customer Projects
    • Led development on key project enhancements.
    • Facilitate User Acceptance Testing with multiple customers.
    • Customize Presentation Logic for Analog RTU data.
    • Write SCADA Application User Guide.

	Customer Migration
    • Refactor customer data from previous Siemens or competitor EMS for use in Sales Demos.

positions.title: Software Simulation Engineer
positions.description:
ACARS (Aircraft Communications Addressing and Reporting System) 
•	Develop and maintain ACARS Message Language to simulate live messaging.
•	Define XML Schema to organize and validate ACARS Message Language.
•	Developed generic parser for ACARS Message Language to share among products.
•	Maintain interface between FMS and ACARS modules to streamline data transfer.
		
FMS (Flight Management System)
•	Managed FMS versions updates for multiple customers.
•	Maintained FMS communication interfaces to aircraft systems
•	Developed and maintained FMS pages.
•	Developed tool to automate creation of FMS page classes from definitions.
		
Navigation
•	Updated flight phase logic to fine-tune interaction between FMS and flight controls.
•	Implemented redesigned fuel system to more accurately calculate FMS predictions.
positions.insights: Skills: Scripting · Integration Testing · .NET Framework · Unit Testing · Agile Development · Logging · Computer Science · XML · Bash · Code Review · Version Control

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
5th generation transmission control module re-architecture project
•	Determined proper size and use of variables.
•	Mapped variables and functions to determine proper system domains.
•	Created classes and design structure in Rational Rhapsody.
•	Used UML to create proper architecture in Rational Rhapsody.
•	Updated tool generated and C code files to C++ in Visual Studio.
•	Relocated global data from 4th generation code to proper privacy headers in C++ classes.
•	Created interface classes between domains in Rational Rhapsody and Visual Studio.
positions.insights: Skills: Scripting · Integration Testing · Unit Testing · Logging · Computer Science · Bash · Code Review · Version Control
